device.description: quad 8-bit voltage-output DAC with common reference and 8-bit parallel input port, one latch per DAC
device.note: tlc7226.pdf (SLAS060F) p.1 (DW/N and FK pinouts, description), p.3 (terminal functions: numbers for DW, N and FK), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 11.4-16.5 V, TTL levels, write timing), p.8 (interface logic, Table 2 function table), p.9 (Figure 6 input control logic)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A latch (Table 2: A1 A0 = 00); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.8); power-on code not stated

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B latch (Table 2: A1 A0 = 01); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.8); power-on code not stated

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC C latch (Table 2: A1 A0 = 10); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.8); power-on code not stated

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC D latch (Table 2: A1 A0 = 11); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.8); power-on code not stated

commands.name: Write DAC latch (WR low)
commands.note: A1 A0 select DAC A-D (Table 2); latch transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.8)

pages: p.1 (DW/N and FK pinouts, description), p.3 (terminal functions: numbers for DW, N and FK), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 11.4-16.5 V, TTL levels, write timing), p.8 (interface logic, Table 2 function table), p.9 (Figure 6 input control logic)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs, reference input REF, single or dual (VSS) supply operation, unipolar/bipolar output configurations, settling
power-on state of the DAC latches is not stated in the datasheet (0 used)
the selected latch is level-transparent while WR is low (output follows the data bus); the model latches the data at WR rising
no chip select: every WR low pulse writes the addressed latch
variants: tlc7226.pdf covers TLC7226C/I/M; the FK (LCCC) package uses the same terminal numbers as DW and N (p.3 footnote).
